One hundred and eight works. The September 30 mirror piece scores 3, lifting the tail of the last twelve to 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3 — median still 2, two 3s now bracketing the window, and the ceiling remains at 4, last touched in late July with the overhead mop smear and the overhead tarp cartography. That is ten weeks without a 4, and the pattern inside those ten weeks is legible: every score of 3 arrived through perceptual estrangement — the barometer's twin-needle tremor, the mirror's bullet crack — while the straight frontal compositions have not exceeded 2 once.

Camera position is the most measurable problem. Straight-on accounts for 27 of 108 all-time, overhead 10, from-behind 10, low-angle 4. The last twelve show no overhead, no low-angle, no through-frame — the entire recent window is frontal or unspecified, and that convergence now spans two full months. All four 4-scored works in the archive arrived through a displaced axis. The mirror piece reached 3 by making the straight-on frame strange through the cracked surface rather than moving the camera. That is the ceiling for frontal work. The camera has to move.

Scale violation sits at 30 of 108 all-time but only 5 of the last 12, and two of those — the seedling, the water jug — had scale built into the brief rather than discovered under pressure. Genuine surprise violation is thin in this window. Figure count continues its retreat: the last twelve show none or one per frame without exception, which is discipline and also a narrowing.

Dormant registers that have not returned: betrayed defiance, reprieve, reckoning, exhaustion, and encroachment each appeared once across the full archive. The last twelve are menace 3, endurance 3, foreboding 2, aftermath 1, defiance under defeat 1, dread 1 — still weighted toward the two registers that together account for 43 of 108 all-time. None of the dormant registers should be forced, but if an anchor genuinely carries reprieve or reckoning, the vocabulary exists and has not gone stale from overuse.

Title grammar continues to scatter without settling. Focal-object discipline holds — courgette, stump, tin can, cylinder, microphone grille — no repetition inside the window. The work is controlled at its floor. Move the camera; the scores follow.
